# WO-2026-08-09-B15-C4 - make the browser operating contract executable, not advisory
# guidance: WO-YYYY-MM-DD-nn — slice title

## Acceptance criteria

AC1 (AMENDED, Larry 2026-08-09 — Keel's M2/C2 was correct) - THE ARTEFACT PRODUCED ON THE PRODUCTION PATH CARRIES THE METHOD. That artefact is the HANDOFF, not the execution packet. Keel established by grep that packet/committedSchema.js carries no method/instructions/prohibited fields and that buildExecutionPacket.test.js hash-pins the producer to it, so making the PACKET carry the contract would need two out-of-surface files AND would duplicate the contract in two artefacts against the SSOT rule. It must live in exactly one place. So: the handoff produced on the production path contains the full BROWSER_METHOD (18 steps) and PROHIBITED_ACTIONS (5) from instructions.js v2, with INSTRUCTIONS_VERSION recorded on it - buildHandoff.js already stamps all three at :462/:499/:514. A handoff built WITHOUT them is REFUSED by the producer, not merely flagged.

AC2 - buildHandoff HAS A PRODUCTION CALLER. Cite the file:line in pipeline/ that reaches it when a shop becomes browser-ready. Prove reachability from the runtime entry, not from a unit test.

AC3 - verifyBasket HAS A PRODUCTION CALLER on the return leg, cited file:line.

AC4 - verificationFor IS TRUTHFUL. realWiring() (runtime.js:797-826) supplies it, so basketHandbackPayload (runtime.js:414) can report a genuine verified/not-verified state. Today it is always null and every handback renders "NOT VERIFIED" by omission (runtime.js:558) - that lie is what AC4 closes.

AC5 - ONE TAB IS ENFORCED, NOT DOCUMENTED. The two direct newTab callers - actions.cjs:8 and readTrolley.cjs:4 - no longer open a tab per invocation. A code path that would open a second page target FAILS LOUDLY. A guard living only inside cdp.js is NOT sufficient: it is bypassable by importing newTab directly, and that is not an invariant.

AC6 - THE SIX MUTATION PROOFS. Each must be shown RED-then-GREEN by deliberately breaking and restoring the behaviour: (a) a second product tab is opened; (b) Regulars/Favourites is bypassed for an ordinary known regular; (c) Brand A-Z ordering is omitted; (d) per-item search becomes the default rather than a bounded fallback; (e) trolley verification is skipped; (f) the BROWSER_METHOD payload is absent from the production execution path. Report the executed count for each - a suite that silently ran nothing is not evidence.

AC7 - NO REGRESSION. Every package suite you touch is green before and after, with counts reported both times.
# guidance: each independently checkable. If automatic, no AC may be satisfiable by a manual invocation of the delivered script alone.
